- Anthropic: recover from stale thinking blocks. Models with preserved thinking (Claude Opus 5.5 and other 5.x models) bind each thinking block to the system prompt, tools and messages before it, and reject a replay with a 400 ("bound to a different conversation") after any of those changed, for example when a refinement re-renders the system prompt. The provider now resends that request once with the `thinking-binding-controls-2026-08-01` beta and `thinking.block_binding.prefix_mismatch_behavior: "drop_block"`, keeps doing so for the rest of the session, and records an `anthropic_stale_thinking_dropped` diagnostic with the number of dropped blocks. Other errors are not retried.
